calls.reason: The claim sets no deadline for its ceiling on industry size. The packet only shows that OpenAI and Anthropic sell paid products and has no revenue figures, so nothing here decides it.

The Sora launch and OpenAI's voice API suggest it had other strengths, but no January 2025 comparison with both Meta and Anthropic shows a clear advantage either way.
